pages.text: The Pestilence is not one sickness but a tide. Every infection, every plague death and every corpse that rises feeds it; it also creeps up a little each day on its own. As it grows it passes through $(4)nine phases$(), each announced by a tolling bell.$(br2)Type $(l)/pestilence$() to see where it stands.

pages.title: Pushing it back
pages.text: The tide also ebbs. Each $(2)cure$(), each $(2)corpse burned$() and each $(2)Afflicted slain$() lowers it, and a phase can fall back as easily as it rose.$(br2)Ignore it, and it will only climb.

pages.title: The early phases
pages.text: $(l)0 Dormant$(): few rats.$(br)$(l)1 Whispers$(): rats in earnest.$(br)$(l)2 Murrain$(): animals catch it and die of it, and their corpses rise.$(br)$(l)3 Rat Season$(): the Afflicted walk at night, even where nothing died.$(br)$(l)4 Outbreak$() and beyond: worse.
